The story and the board give the same answer.

24 boxes, with 36 markers in each one.

Don't add the bottom numbers too. 1/2 + 1/4 is not 2/6.

Count by each bottom number.

Fourths and halves are different sizes.

Then take away pieces.
You have done this before. Cut the half right down the middle.

That would say you still have a whole pizza after eating half of one, and that cannot be right.

Park that 2 somewhere safe and leave the pieces alone for a minute.

Put it with the 2 wholes we parked, and the hike is 3 1/4 miles.
Don't add the bottom numbers when you add the pieces. 1/2 + 3/4 is not 4/6.

Start with the pieces, and we hit a wall right away.

Put the rectangle on one square meter.
